verdicts.explanation: Table 1 lists the ionic conductivity of the LLZO electrolyte as 5.5 × 10−6 S m−1 with footnote (iv) citing Buschmann et al. (2012), so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature for this value (T = 298 K is the simulation temperature), so null is right, and the secondary fields are null as the paper does not state them for this material.
